propositions: When a plan's source-code reference inventory is hand-enumerated or demonstrably incomplete, the reviewer should be coached to re-derive it using symbol-graph tools and string-literal sweeps that LSP cannot resolve.

A project-only criterion keyed 'project.symbol-reference-completeness' with advisory posture must route to plan_review only, not code_review, because code-review's closed applies_when vocabulary prevents project.* criteria from ever entering the move applicability set.

Code-review moves are already overlay-driven via code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring is required; the overlay machinery exists and shipped defaults remain untouched.

The criterion fires reliably on hand-enumerated plans at agent tier, identifying omitted files including string-literal sites that find_referencing_symbols cannot resolve, but the distinctive method coaching reaches an agent only through LLM coach selection, which consistently prefers blocking built-ins over advisory moves.
